correctness.rationale: For arbitrary bivariate copula with uniform U,V (singular allowed) and independent Bernoulli retention p, write centered conditional CDF d(u,v)=P(V<=v|U=u)−v. Reflection maps it to −d(u,1−v); split d into antisymmetric E=(d(v)−d(1−v))/2 and symmetric O=(d(v)+d(1−v))/2. The two are orthogonal in joint L², and new fluctuation equals E+(2p−1)O. For folded uniform T=2min(V,1−V), its conditional CDF fluctuation is 2E(u,t/2), so xi(T|U)=24||E||². Therefore xi(Wp|U)=(2p−1)²xi(V|U)+p(1−p)xi(T|U). Standard total-variance equality 0 iff independence, 1 iff measurable response gives the sharp upper 1−3p(1−p) and complete equality/zero conditions (p=1/2 special). Mixture V=U with probability a, otherwise independent uniform, produces xi(V|U)=xi(T|U)=a² for all a∈[0,1], realizing entire interval. At p=1/2 response-reflection symmetry forces Kendall tau and Spearman rho zero. Fresh exact Fraction integration over 100 nonsymmetric 4×4 checkerboard channel cases corroborated identity and capacity; unrestricted result follows from orthogonal conditional CDF proof.
risk: For p!=1/2 the zero and upper equality conditions involve original V; for p=1/2 only folded T, not necessarily V.
Random orientation coin must be independent; xi direction response conditioned on predictor U is fixed; density not required.

value.rationale: Independent random response reflection models latent orientation/sign ambiguity and is meaningful for directional rank prediction. The exact all-copula attenuation law determines each post-noise xi, the sharp full capacity interval and a genuine phase switch in equality conditions at a fair coin, while explaining zero Kendall and Spearman yet surviving directional rank dependence. The previously known 1/4 example is ancillary, not the main contribution.
